preparation_scope: R4 user-authorized offline N1/N2 correction, unfinished contract/design/validation-plan completion and static sealing only. No authorization/release/runtime token is created by this artifact.

official_evidence.limit: Reuses frozen local textual evidence; no fresh official-document query or expansion. Copy hash is identity, not authenticity/target-OS proof.

native_boundary.scope_warning: A caller-controlled kind string or receipt proves no real OS property. All FAKE_* acceptance, and inherited projection labels such as MEASURED/VERIFIED_PRIVATE_JOB/REVIEWED_JOB_ACCOUNTING_TOTAL, remain fixture-only.

budget_separation: These 9000s overall/7200s native proposals are unchanged source contracts. R4 offline preparation has its separate 2400s budget; it does not create a native run budget or share phase time.

construction.dependencies: Inject the unchanged accepted resource_connection and control only in a separately approved future harness. Code documents identity pinning as harness duty; it does not verify module hashes itself.
construction.contract_check: proposal_limits must equal source LIMITS exactly; phase binding later names a phase from unchanged contract.phase_limits_s.
construction.clock_identity: One ResourceSession is constructed, snapshotted and retained. Actual independent clock capture is still OPEN; input fields establish internal consistency only.
construction.anchors_restriction: ResourceSession accepts scalar anchor values only and run_id must match start_record. Provider copies anchors/capabilities/bounds; fake root handle is seeded in retained map.

bounds.meaning: Positive supplied finite fixture bounds; pointer_bytes is not actual adapter architecture evidence.

construction.capabilities: force_only_explicitly_approved must be false at construction. pre_resume_check requires cooperative_stop='SUPPORTED_VERIFIED' and evidence_scope='FAKE_TEST_ONLY'; actual COMSOL stop remains OPEN.
construction.outputs: Exactly body/wrapper/temp/final categories, exclusive_new=true and root_identity tokens; all under lexical umbrella, no overlap with originals; overlapping roots count once. Logical-byte baseline0 is a fixture/ownership declaration, not actual filesystem verification.

common_seam_protocol.request_arrival: _call records request via _now, invokes one supplied operation, then arrival via _now; trace includes operation/request/arrival/observed/query_success/error_code/failure.
common_seam_protocol.job_operations: _job_call prepends the explicit owned job_token and requires the same token in result; no NULL ambient/default Job.
common_seam_protocol.normalization: Successful error_code=None is this fake protocol, not a claim that Win32 GetLastError automatically clears on success. Native error capture/translation remains OPEN.
common_seam_protocol.failure: Exceptions are captured with exception_type/message and winerror if supplied, followed by arrival clock where possible. No false query becomes zero/complete. Only membership fake error234 may request bounded larger capacity.
common_seam_protocol.time_limit: Entire active sampling transaction <=1s, every observed counter fresh at end, first/subsequent arrival gap<=6s BEFORE updating cursor. This is a checked receipt contract, not real-time scheduling guarantee.

seams.name: clock
receipt_fields_and_conditions: run_id, clock_id, clock_origin equal the one ResourceSession.clock context
seams.call_count_contract: One per _now. Normal _call uses one request and one arrival clock, plus explicit transaction/action clocks. Early failure can shorten this; final prior-failure fast return uses zero.
seams.scope_limit: Synthetic clock receipt only; not a measured QPC binding.

seams.name: pre_resume_receipts
receipt_fields_and_conditions: common operation envelope plus exact job_token
seams.call_count_contract: One receipt call per successful fresh pre_resume_check; no create/set/assign/resume operation is implemented.
seams.scope_limit: Cooperative capability must separately be fake SUPPORTED_VERIFIED. No actual cap/startup-disk enforcement.

seams.name: job_members
receipt_fields_and_conditions: pids list length==returned_count; each positive integer; unique
pointer_bytes matches bound; returned_bytes between 8+count*pointer_bytes and 8+capacity*pointer_bytes
false query allowed only fake error_code=234 with increasing required_capacity<=max_members
seams.call_count_contract: Initial capacity min(16,max_members); at most max_membership_attempts<=3 each membership acquisition. Active sample acquires two bookends; terminal acquires one non-active list.
seams.scope_limit: Raw Win32 buffer/layout/error code binding is OPEN; pointer_bytes is a fixture declaration.

seams.name: retain_member
receipt_fields_and_conditions: pid exact; positive creation_filetime; nonempty member_token not literal NULL
member_token not already retained for another entry
seams.call_count_contract: At most once per newly seen PID while retained map size<max_retained_members; existing root is seeded by anchors.
seams.scope_limit: No OpenProcess call or real handle retention.

seams.name: process_identity
seams.call_count_contract: One per member per identity pass; successful sample has two identity passes, including members already retained.
seams.scope_limit: Retained same-token consistency only; no actual GetProcessTimes.

seams.name: root_state
receipt_fields_and_conditions: root_token/pid/creation_filetime exact; signaled must be bool
terminal route additionally requires signaled=true, exit_query_succeeded=true, exit_code type int
seams.call_count_contract: One per normal sample; one per terminal acquisition, including final internal terminal re-observation.
seams.scope_limit: Returned integer is synthetic; actual exit query/range/ABI mapping remains OPEN.

seams.name: process_rss
seams.call_count_contract: Once per unique member in accepted sample; sum must fit U64.
seams.scope_limit: Not native RSS evidence or distinct-resident-physical-memory measurement.

seams.name: job_commit
seams.call_count_contract: One per attempted complete sample after member counters.
seams.scope_limit: No public current Job commit API chosen. Fake SHA is fixture binding, not approved runtime token.

seams.name: host_counters
receipt_fields_and_conditions: commit_total<=commit_limit; physical_available<=physical_total; all products fit U64
seams.call_count_contract: One in accepted sample; one after internal terminal in successful final tail.

seams.name: disk_space
seams.call_count_contract: One in accepted sample; one after host query in successful final tail.
seams.scope_limit: Caller quota meaning retained; no equality of caller total and whole-volume free is required.

seams.name: output_walk
receipt_fields_and_conditions: root_observations exactly each unique declared path; identity_before==identity_after==declared identity; reparse=false
entries list <=max_output_entries; each path under exactly one normalized walk root; depth<=max_output_depth; not original
each entry reparse=false; known_owned=true; original=false; kind file/directory; identity_before==identity_after nonempty; link_count==1
logical_bytes uint, directory logical_bytes=0; duplicate same path must have same identity/kind/size; distinct path identity alias rejected
seams.call_count_contract: One per accepted sample and one in successful final tail.
seams.scope_limit: Only validates supplied synthetic metadata. Actual walk completeness/no-follow/race guarantees OPEN.

seams.name: stop_observation
receipt_fields_and_conditions: remaining_members is list; every pid maps to exact retained (creation_filetime,member_token)
ownership_verified/job_empty/root_signaled/exit_query_succeeded feed unchanged control as boolean predicates
unattributed_processes and handle_errors retained for unchanged control
close action additionally requires root_token match and exit_code type int
seams.call_count_contract: One per stop_step before one unchanged control.advance_stop call; no action is dispatched if returned UNRESOLVED or error is truthy.
seams.scope_limit: No actual stop/exit/ownership query; fake missing/false values cannot authorize unknown-process force.

seams.name: cooperative_request
receipt_fields_and_conditions: request_accepted true marks accepted request; other value sets cooperative_request_failed
seams.call_count_contract: At most one per coordinator; increment attempt before seam call.
seams.scope_limit: Accepted request is not stop/exit confirmation and not verified COMSOL capability.

seams.name: force_job
receipt_fields_and_conditions: termination_request_accepted true records force request success
seams.call_count_contract: At most one per coordinator; increment attempt before seam call.
seams.scope_limit: No actual TerminateJobObject; never implies graceful or completed termination.

seams.name: close_owned
seams.call_count_contract: Only after unchanged control verifies termination; then one post-close clock read occurs before _closed=true. Further seam calls are refused.
seams.scope_limit: Synthetic closure only; actual handles/Parent lifecycle integration OPEN.

seams.name: final_write
receipt_fields_and_conditions: record_token nonempty; bytes uint; sha256 lowercase 64 hex
seams.call_count_contract: Zero on existing failure or bad final stop-state preflight. One if flow reaches writer. No retry inside method.
seams.scope_limit: Fake writer receipt; does not modify actual Parent or write a real runtime record.

seams.name: final_readback_hash
seams.call_count_contract: Zero when blocked before writer. One after accepted writer receipt if flow reaches readback.
seams.scope_limit: Synthetic readback/hash equality, not actual runtime persistence proof.

pre_resume.checks: Receipt-only start order/cap/identity/cooperative fake capability. Startup disk16GiB check, creation, cap setting and resume are not implemented.

sequence: collect_owned_sample checks prepared/no latched failure/no terminal
clock start; bounded membership before; identity/retain each member; root_state
one RSS per member; synthetic current commit; host; disk; output
bounded membership after; identical identity bookends
cursor changes only if decision status CONTINUE_WITHIN_SAMPLED_LIMITS
sample.failure: STOP_REQUIRED, cursor unchanged; later sample_once returns LATCHED_MONITOR_FAILURE.
sample.aggregation: Unique member WorkingSetSize sum, no root/Job double-add; shared physical pages can be counted multiple times. Root can exit while retained owned children remain. Empty active Job routes to terminal observation; it is never a complete zero sample.
sample.disk_projection: raw.disk_raw keeps three quota/volume values; raw.volume_free_bytes uses caller_available_bytes with disk_projection='CONSERVATIVE_CALLER_AVAILABLE_NOT_RAW_VOLUME_FREE'. This is explicitly conservative legacy projection, not renaming the raw volume counter.
sample.scheduler: No sleep/timer/scheduler or compile/batch launcher implemented. sample_interval_s=5 is preserved contract, with production scheduling OPEN.

terminal.sequence: Checks prepared ownership, bounded active=false membership empty, retained root signaled and successful exit query, valid transaction and prior valid sample.
terminal.failure_public: Public wrapper catches helper exception once through _failure; default returned status STOP_REQUIRED.
terminal.failure_internal: Internal helper raises. Final outer catch owns this new failure once; no error dict is indexed as a terminal result.
terminal.existing_failure: A later successful public observation may record physical-state fixture evidence, with monitor_failure_preserved=true. It does not clear prior failures or restore final eligibility.
terminal.previous_terminal: A failed attempt does not erase an earlier _terminal observation; preserved observation is not proof that a later query succeeded.

stop.control: Unchanged control.advance_stop once per reached step; existing bounded cleanup/overall deadlines and reserve logic.
stop.n2: After dict check and saving full out, UNRESOLVED status OR truthy error causes one latch before action lookup/dispatch. Returned transition is preserved in detail.
stop.actions: At most one fake cooperative/force/close action per step, with at-most-once cooperative and force attempts. No unknown PID or process-name kill.
stop.request_vs_result: Request receipt != Job-empty/root-signaled/exit-query proof. All failures and unresolved ownership remain incomplete. Last-handle/close receipt never means graceful success.

final.initial_existing_failure: Before try/clock/writer: return _failure_result('INCOMPLETE'), no append or dependency call.
final.defensive_stop_guard: If no prior failure, saved _stop_state must be None or neither status UNRESOLVED nor truthy error. Otherwise outer catch latches FINAL_STOP_CONTROL_UNRESOLVED_OR_ERROR, operation advance_stop, detail full state, before writer.
final.remaining_preconditions: Existing terminal observation; decision overall/normal_gate both INCOMPLETE and no prior decision errors/reason; bound independent final phase.
sequence: one fake final_write and budget check
one final_readback_hash matching bytes/hash + budget check
fresh private terminal observation, host, disk and output
post-required-operations clock, full resource-tail transaction/freshness, final phase/overall deadline and reserves
final.gates: overall INCOMPLETE; normal_gate INCOMPLETE; approved/usable/native_ready false
final.lifecycle: Closed coordinator refuses further seam calls. No complete production handoff among stop close, final writer, child rc and Parent.S1FinalReturn is implemented.

failure_latch.append_owner: _failure(exc,status='STOP_REQUIRED') alone appends a new failure record.
failure_latch.first: _failures[0] remains first_error; subsequent independently encountered failures remain ordered followup_errors.
failure_latch.read_only_result: _failure_result(status) returns deep copies of existing first/followup errors without clock/query/append; it is internal and only called with nonempty latch.
failure_latch.n1_once: Public terminal wrapper OR final outer catch owns a given helper exception, never both.
failure_latch.n2_once: Returned bad control transition is latched by a direct return through _failure, not latched and then thrown into outer catch again.
failure_latch.idempotence: Repeated final entry after any existing latch returns same error sequence without adding guard-error duplicates. This is final-entry idempotence, not global deduplication of new independent failing public operations.
failure_latch.no_reset: No error list, cursor, clock origin, previous terminal or accepted control state is cleared to regain success.
failure_latch.original_reason: Terminal helper reason is retained. For N2, wrapper reason is explicit and original control.error/status/next_action/deadlines remain unmodified in record.detail.
failure_latch.final_guard_reason: FINAL_STOP_CONTROL_UNRESOLVED_OR_ERROR is separate from a reached stop_step failure; subsequent final entries do not append again.

future_validation_call_count_contract.scope: Count final attempt separately from already attempted terminal query
future_validation_call_count_contract.new_failure_records: One on public terminal failure; final adds0; no FAKE_FINAL_BOUNDARY_CHECKED

future_validation_call_count_contract.case: N1 internal terminal failure after good write/readback
future_validation_call_count_contract.preconditions: Valid prior terminal, no previous latch, writer+readback accepted; only final internal terminal fails
future_validation_call_count_contract.new_failure_records: One final outer-catch record retaining original reason, no public-wrapper duplicate

future_validation_call_count_contract.case: N2 returned UNRESOLVED or truthy error
future_validation_call_count_contract.new_failure_records: One STOP_CONTROL_UNRESOLVED_OR_ERROR; existing first preserved if this is a followup

future_validation_call_count_contract.case: Defensive final bad stop state with empty failure latch

future_validation_call_count_contract.counts: Bound separately in changed-branch plan; successful fake outcome only
future_validation_call_count_contract.new_failure_records: None when all branch prerequisites and receipts are valid; gates stay INCOMPLETE
